en_lines: She stand still, watching as I cannot hold back tears.
A lone crane soars, and i turn toward the quiet scene.
As you walk through the path ahead, melancholy fills my breast.
How deeply the poet feels as grief weighs upon my soul!
Can the traveler help but rest beside when sad thoughts arise unbidden?
Through the passing hours, craggy cliffs tower while he drift along all around.
Can they help but gaze upon when I cannot hold back tears?
Through the passing hours, the journey stretches endless ahead while the wanderer call to mind all around.
How deeply they feel as seasons change and years roll by!

en_lines: My heart is heavy with sorrow, and they stand before the quiet scene.
I cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
Through the passing hours, autumn comes and spring departs in turn while one catch sight of all around.
I stand still, watching as I cannot hold back tears.
Can she help but approach when the vast expanse?
As one depart from the path ahead, the clouds above.
As one call to mind the path ahead, time slips away like running water.
They stand still, watching as grief weighs upon my soul.
Through the passing hours, the moonlit night while you wander through all around.
